intended_object: For subgroups H ≤ K of a group G, the natural G-equivariant map G/H → G/K of left coset spaces, gH ↦ gK (from docstring and name).
explanation: The underlying function is Mathlib's Subgroup.quotientMapOfLE (gH ↦ gK), and equivariance is proved with respect to the standard left multiplication action of G on G ⧸ H and G ⧸ K (MulAction.Quotient). This is exactly the standard equivariant map, including degenerate cases (H = K gives the identity, K = G gives the map to a point). The setting, a group G with nested subgroups, is the natural one. Mathlib has the plain function Subgroup.quotientMapOfLE and the related MulActionHom.toQuotient : G →[G] G ⧸ H, but no bundled MulActionHom version of G/H → G/K, so this is not a duplicate. Subgroup.quotientMapOfLE is cited as the closest counterpart, though it is only the unbundled function.
